images.title: Multiply top, multiply bottom
images.purpose: Show a/b × c/d = (a × c)/(b × d) on 2/3 × 3/5 with a grid.
images.composition: One unit square centred with the rule line beneath.
exact_structure: One unit square split into 3 equal columns and 5 equal rows: 15 equal cells; grid grey #6B7280.
The left 2 columns are tinted teal #0072B2 (that is 2/3).
The top 3 rows are tinted amber #E69F00 (that is 3/5).
The overlap, 2 columns by 3 rows, is 6 cells filled reddish purple #CC79A7.
Beneath, one line: the two fractions then the numerators and denominators multiplied.
rejection: teal not exactly 2 columns or amber not exactly 3 rows
images.takeaway: Overlap cells are the numerators multiplied, all cells are the denominators multiplied.
images.description: A 3 by 5 grid where 2 columns and 3 rows overlap in 6 purple cells out of 15.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Count the 6 overlap cells and the 15 cells in all.

image_decisions.why: Overlap of two strips shows the rule on a small example.
